title: Toward SLM-based agentic task-tool intent matching
abstract: Tool-equipped AI agents use tool calls to access data and act on external systems. The study investigates Small Language Models as task-tool relevance classifiers that independently evaluate selected tools against an assigned task, using a multi-tool dataset spanning distinct MCP servers and specialization through prompt optimization, supervised fine-tuning, and GRPO.
